description: Vcad for Power BI is a cutting-edge custom visual that bridges the gap between data analytics and Building Information Modeling, offering a powerful and seamless way to visualize and interact with 2D and 3D models directly within Power BI dashboards. Designed for AEC professionals, facility managers, property and asset managers, data analysts, and project stakeholders, Vcad revolutionizes how spatial and non-spatial data are integrated and analyzed. It supports models in widely used formats, including IFC, Revit, Navisworks, InfraWorks, DWG, and more, and allows users to explore them in fully interactive environments embedded directly into Power BI reports. This enables the connection between physical building elements and analytical data, providing a visual understanding that goes far beyond traditional charts and tables. One of Vcad’s key strengths is its ability to automatically generate Power BI templates, ready for immediate use and customization. This greatly accelerates report creation and allows users to begin analyzing data right away, without having to build dashboards from scratch. Vcad makes it easy to navigate models, filter, colour and select elements, highlight areas based on custom parameters, and focus on specific floors or components, all while maintaining full synchronization between the model and analytical data.
